Adept at leading end-to-end AI lifecycle from R&D to production with MLflow, Docker, Git, and Grafana for scalable deployments.

raw_sections.experience:
Professional Experience
GSPANN Technologies | Apr 2024 – Present Senior Technical Lead (AI/GenAI)
Leading AI/GenAI solution design & delivery for enterprise clients. • Designed and deployed a Cross-Sell Lead Generation system for medical hardware & consumables using ML + NLP pipelines.
Built Multi-Agent Orchestration frameworks using LangGraph (Supervisor → SubAgents
→ Tools).
Delivered enterprise GenAI Ops solutions for document search, compliance, and
knowledge management.
Established LLMOps pipelines with MLflow + Docker + Git. •
Integrated Grafana dashboards and AIOps practices for monitoring AI systems.
EFKON India Pvt Ltd | Aug 2021 – Mar 2024 Product Development & Delivery (AI/GenAI) Team Lead
Built high-speed ANPR systems and Smart City video analytics. • Delivered LLM + RAG pipelines for construction document analysis. • Introduced LLMOps pipelines for model versioning and governance. • Deployed AI at scale with Docker, Git, MLflow, Grafana monitoring.
Vaaan Infra Pvt Ltd | Nov 2018 – Aug 2021 R&D (AI) Team Lead
Delivered multilingual ANPR and AI-powered toll solutions. • Introduced AI Ops automation practices for retraining and deployment.
Roboflux Technologies | Nov 2016 – Aug 2018 Technical Consultant (AI/ML)
Developed computer vision and NLP applications (OCR, logo detection, sentiment
analysis APIs).
Delivered gesture-controlled robotics and IoT-based monitoring solutions. • Implemented Git and Docker for project delivery.
Infi Zeal Technologies | Nov 2013 – Aug 2016 Embedded Systems Developer
Designed automation circuits and IoT solutions with embedded AI. • Delivered home automation, gesture-controlled ARM, and footfall detection systems.
Corporate Training & Mentoring
Delivered AI/ML/GenAI corporate training programs tailored for MSMEs, focusing on cost-effective adoption of emerging technologies. • Conducted workshops on AI-driven automation, predictive analytics, and computer vision to help MSMEs scale operations. • Mentored MSME leadership teams on practical applications of GenAI, including document automation, RAG-based knowledge management, and customer support bots. • Designed simplified training modules on Python, MLflow, Hugging Face, and LangChain to upskill MSME developers and engineers. • Assisted MSMEs in building low-cost AI pipelines using open-source tools (Docker, Git, Grafana) for monitoring and governance.
raw_sections.projects:
Major Projects • Cross-Sell Lead Generation (Healthcare): AI-powered recommendation engine using ML
+ NLP for medical hardware & consumables.
Multi-Agent Orchestration (Agentic AI): Supervisor → Sub-Agents → Tools system with
autonomous routing, retrieval, and execution.
Electronic Enforcement System: Smart City AI for traffic violations (helmet, overspeed,
red-light jumping, illegal parking).
Multilingual ANPR: Vehicle plate recognition in English + Indian regional languages. • International ANPR (Istanbul): Vehicle recognition with speed & weight detection.
GenAI + RAG Pipelines: Retrieval-augmented LLM systems for construction &
compliance document analysis. • Complaint Sentiment Analysis (NLP).
